definition: Asendin is an antidepressant medicine in the tricyclic dibenzoxazepine group. It is used to treat depression symptoms and works mainly by reducing the reuptake of norepinephrine, and to a lesser extent serotonin, while also affecting dopamine and other receptor systems.
